x: Maynard, a new club member, walked in fine style to win, followed by two of our Police friends, Tasker and Noonan, both of whom we hope will soon be members of the Club.
James, Tasker, Oliver and Robins were second in the handicap team race and our "A" Team with Sapcote, Bellchamber, McMullen and East were third in the handicap team race.

Frank Tasker was in a fearful temper with the club whippers, but walking all the better for it. In the last Belgravian we suggested Frank Tasker should take the bit between his teeth and have a go, but instead he indulged in a most revolting display of gnashing of teeth at well meaning supporters.
